appearance: Elderly researcher with grey hair, a white lab coat, and brown slacks.
personality: Warm and encouraging, prone to lecturing, occasionally forgetful.
backstory: Kanto's foremost Pokémon researcher; sends new trainers out to fill the Pokédex.
motivation: Complete the Pokédex through a new generation of trainers.
speechStyle: Formal but kindly; fond of explaining how the world works.
